layouts.name: Harewood Hillclimb
layouts.description: Draft open Harewood hillclimb follows the complete independently mapped corner sequence, including Orchard, Farmhouse, Country, Esses, Quarry, Clark, Willow and Chippy. The private start and finish agree with the two source endpoints. The planar source trace measures approximately 1.434 km; the supplied 1.509 km distance differs. No course coordinates are scaled, bridged or closed artificially.
